thesis: Joe Liemandt argues that Alpha School is redefining education by making it so engaging that students beg to avoid summer breaks and achieve learning outcomes ten times faster than traditional schools. He claims this is accomplished by compressing academics into two hours using an AI tutoring engine, while dedicating the remaining four hours to non-screen, project-based workshops focused on life skills like leadership, entrepreneurship, and financial literacy.
